title: Rainbows
examples: How do rainbows form in the sky?
What are the colors in a rainbow?
Can I see a rainbow without rain?

explain.say: Rainbows happen when sunlight shines through raindrops.
Raindrops bend the light and split it into colours.
A rainbow has seven colours, always in the same order.
Red is on the outside of the bow. Violet is on the inside.
To see a rainbow, stand with the Sun behind you. The rain is in front of you.

draw.text: Sun behind you, rain in front

explain.say: Look for a rainbow after a sunny shower.

faq.q: Why are the colors always in the same order?
faq.a: Light bends the same way in every raindrop. So the colours always come in the same order.
asks: What is the correct rainbow color sequence?
Does the order of colors change?

faq.q: Do I need the sun to see a rainbow?
faq.a: Yes. You need sunlight shining through raindrops.
asks: Can rainbows happen without the sun?
Is sunlight necessary for a rainbow?

faq.q: What is the difference between a rainbow and a prism?
faq.a: A prism is a solid piece of glass that splits light into colours. A raindrop does the same.
We usually name seven colours. Really, the colours blend into each other.
asks: How many colors are in a rainbow?

faq.q: Can I see a rainbow if it is cloudy?
faq.a: You need the Sun to shine through the rain. If clouds cover the Sun, you will not see one.
asks: Is the sky needing to be clear?

facts: Rainbows are caused by the reflection and refraction of sunlight.
The seven colors are red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet.
The order of colors always goes from red on the outer edge to violet on the inner edge.
Raindrops act like tiny natural prisms.

quiz.say: What must shine through the raindrops to make a rainbow?
quiz.why: Sunlight has all the colours in it. Raindrops split them up.

wrong.1: Starlight is far too faint to make a rainbow.
wrong.2: A torch is too small to light a whole sky of rain.

quiz.say: Which colour is on the inside of a rainbow?
quiz.why: Violet is always on the inside of the bow.

wrong.0: Red is on the outside of the bow.
wrong.2: Orange sits next to red, near the outside.

quiz.say: Which colour is on the outside of a rainbow?
quiz.why: Red is always on the outside of the bow.

wrong.0: Blue is near the inside of the bow.
